name: Residencia Temporal -- Multi-Entry Business Subcategory

qualifying_event.description: A foreign national who must enter Chile regularly to carry out executive or managerial activities related to a business or investment held by a Chilean company applies for the Multi-Entry Business subcategory of Residencia Temporal.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Letter from the foreign institution specifying the applicant's function and business-related income.

requirements.blocker_text: Regular entry required for executive or managerial activities tied to a business or investment held by a Chilean company.
Apostilled/legalized letter from the foreign institution specifying the applicant's function, interests, and business-related income.
Total stay may not exceed 6 months (approx. 180 days) in each calendar year.

evidence_required.document: Document explaining visit reasons and economic/commercial interests

outcome.duration_length: multiple entries per year, up to 6 months total stay per calendar year

sources.title: serviciomigraciones.cl (SERMIG) -- Multi-Entry Business subcategory: for recurring executive/managerial entries tied to a Chilean company's business or investments; capped at 6 months total stay per calendar year; family members may qualify as dependents under Article 74 of Law 21.325; application from outside Chile only

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Chile). Modeled PUBLISHED -- directly tier-1 sourced. This is structurally a frequent-flyer executive permit, not a settlement route: it does not lead to permanent residence or citizenship under the terms found (leads_to_pr/leads_to_citizenship both false), distinguishing it clearly from cl_investor_residence.json's capital-investment route, which does lead onward. duration_type is 'rolling_window' to reflect the per-calendar-year cap on cumulative days rather than a single continuous permit period.
